added: packages/live-store (@sos-2/live-store): durable, provider-neutral repositories for the live product state — Mission, Context, SystemState, Evidence (immutable), Architecture, Candidate, Assurance, Experiment, Decision, AuthorityGrant, Package, history (ArchitectureMemory + CausalHypothesis), development state, task state (the full §6 task-durability shape: task identity + mission link, plan/work graph, owned revisions, authority context, body lease ref, checkpoints, content-addressed artifacts, observations, unresolved uncertainty, retries/recovery, resource usage, final verification), body lease state and observation events — plus the provider PORTS for the free-tier reference stack (PostgresStoreAdapter -> Neon durable-canonical-state; RedisCoordinationAdapter -> Upstash cache/leases/idempotency ONLY, documented NEVER-CANONICAL; ObjectStoreAdapter -> Cloudflare R2 large immutable artifacts by content hash) and a COMPLETE in-memory reference implementation of all three; semantic discipline machine-pinned: verbatim preservation with round-trip equality on the spine's canonical serialization, idempotent writes (identical replay is a no-op returning the stored record), stale-revision detection with typed conflicts carrying the current revision, expected-revision CAS, immutable-record collision detection, event ingestion with replay protection keyed on the durable event index (coordination idempotency is a fast path only — a flushed/removed/FAILING Redis never rejects a first delivery), lease truth recomputed from durable records + injected clock

packages/api-contracts (@sos-2/api-contracts): the typed API boundary — transport-agnostic request/response envelopes (hostable on plain Node today, Vercel functions or an external worker boundary later WITHOUT contract change), typed error envelopes (UNKNOWN 500, UNAVAILABLE 503, CONFLICT/stale-revision 409, DUPLICATE/replayed 409, NOT_FOUND 404, INVALID 400), deterministic base64url-over-canonical-JSON seek pagination cursors (malformed cursors are typed INVALID, never a silent reset), revision headers (x-sos-artifact-id / x-sos-revision / x-sos-expected-revision), event ingestion payloads (every event carries an id; opaque canonical-JSON payloads preserved verbatim) and provider-health payloads (typed AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN, never conflated, never fabricated); zero external runtime dependencies — the only dependency is the workspace spine whose vocabulary is consumed verbatim

apps/api (@sos-2/api): the live API service over the live-store ports (in-memory reference backend; provider adapters attach later without contract change) — mission/system-state/evidence/task/body-lease/observation reads+writes (idempotent PUTs with typed conflict mapping, revision headers, CAS), POST /events event ingestion with replay protection, and GET /health reporting per-provider availability as typed UNKNOWN when unconfigured; a plain Node process (node:http, repo-standard ESM + tsc build, no vendor framework) whose transport-agnostic handler performs only bounded store operations (no long-running work inside the request lifetime, 1 MiB body guard); the composition root is the only impure boundary (SystemClock + port injected at startup, mirroring the apps/console precedent)
preserved_invariants: the frozen W0-W18 core is untouched: no file outside the owned paths packages/live-store, packages/api-contracts and apps/api was modified (spec/, docs/, scripts/, .github/ and every existing packages/* and apps/* source remain byte-identical to the base head)

the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope/kind/trace/serialization authority: the live store never mints ids, never rewrites content, never redefines envelope or record shapes — it stores and returns the owning packages' records verbatim, validated by their own asserts (consumed), and every round-trip equality is pinned on the spine's canonical serialization (AGENTS.md §4, no second semantic registry)
semantic IDs and exact revisions are preserved verbatim: the store returns the record it was given, never re-mints ids and never rewrites content (pinned per family by tests)

truth states and provenance are preserved bit-exact: all six distinct evidence truth states survive store->load round trips without conflation (UNAVAILABLE is never folded into SUCCESS or read as absence-of-failure), and provenance/exact source+deployment+subject revisions are carried verbatim (spec/architecture.md §18, spec/architecture-lock.md)

Redis/queues are never canonical (spec/productization-requirements.md, docs/deployment/free-tier-plan.md): the coordination port is cache/leases/idempotency ONLY; a full flush, complete removal or typed UNAVAILABLE failure of the coordination layer provably leaves every semantic fact intact and queryable from the durable store, keeps replay protection correct against the durable event index, and recomputes lease truth from durable records plus the injected clock (pinned by tests)

LLM output is never authoritative evidence or authorization: the live store is a persistence boundary — it stores records that carry their own provenance and non-authoritative marks verbatim and adds no authority of its own (spec/architecture.md §18 preserved by non-interference)

provider outages remain truthful UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE states (spec/productization-requirements.md): provider health is a typed record (AVAILABLE only when probed, UNAVAILABLE when configured and failing, UNKNOWN when unconfigured — the honest state of the in-memory reference backend), failing provider operations throw typed ProviderUnavailableError mapped to 503 UNAVAILABLE, and no handler ever fabricates success (pinned by tests)

determinism: no Date.now / Math.random / fetch / process.env reads in package src — clocks are injected through the Clock port (ManualClock in tests), ordering is deterministic everywhere and all tests run offline; the only impure spots live in the apps/api composition root (SystemClock + API_PORT at the entry), mirroring the frozen apps/console precedent

pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml remain unchanged (the lockfile is untracked in this repository; git diff on both is empty and the resolved external dependency set is identical to the base) — zero new external dependencies, workspace :* packages and the repository's existing toolchain only; no vendor SDK is added in this Work Order
boundary_changes: three new workspace members under the already-globbed packages/* and apps/* (no pnpm-workspace.yaml change): @sos-2/live-store (runtime deps: @sos-2/semantic-spine, @sos-2/mission, @sos-2/context, @sos-2/system-state, @sos-2/evidence, @sos-2/architecture, @sos-2/assurance, @sos-2/experiments, @sos-2/decision, @sos-2/authority, @sos-2/packages, @sos-2/memory, @sos-2/causal; devDep @sos-2/telemetry for test fixtures), @sos-2/api-contracts (runtime dep @sos-2/semantic-spine only) and @sos-2/api (runtime deps @sos-2/api-contracts, @sos-2/live-store, @sos-2/semantic-spine; type-only devDeps @sos-2/mission/@sos-2/evidence/@sos-2/system-state)

the dependency edges are one-directional and acyclic: live-store and api-contracts consume the merged frozen domain packages and are consumed by nothing at this base except apps/api (live-store <- api-contracts-free; api <- live-store + api-contracts); no frozen package gains a dependency, and P1/P3 sibling waves are not referenced

the provider ports are a PROVIDER boundary, not a semantic one: PostgresStoreAdapter / RedisCoordinationAdapter / ObjectStoreAdapter live behind the live-store facade, document their free-tier roles (Neon durable, Upstash coordination-only-never-canonical, R2 immutable artifacts) and are satisfied by the in-memory reference implementation — real SDK adapters arrive in later waves as optional peers WITHOUT contract change; domain packages never import provider specifics

the execution-fabric record shapes (TaskRecord per spec/productization-execution-architecture.md §6, BodyLeaseRecord per §1/§3, ObservationEventRecord per §5, DevelopmentStateRecord) are new P2-owned operational vocabulary, NOT Semantic Spine artifacts: task/lease/event ids are execution-fabric ids, spine artifacts are referenced by their well-formed sos:// ids where they exist, and these records are documented as the work order's own boundary (mirroring how W12 documented adapter control-plane fields)
